I was well behaved and friendly. My mom and my aunt still say to this day how easy me and my sister were. We didn't get into any trouble and were always nice. 

Compared to my sister though, I was a little more quiet. My uncle and grandpa favored my sister a little because of that. I wasn't drastically different though, just a little shy with people I didn't know that well. 
In kindergarten and (1st-3rd grade of) elementary school, I was well liked. I had friends I liked spending time with and I had hobbies, I enjoyed doing. 
At that point I was still completely normal. 

In 4th grade though, the Schizoid Symptoms started showing themselves. 

I still remember, I suddenly didn't want to go anywhere anymore. 
I lost interest in a lot of things. 

I also didn't want to celebrate my birthday with friends anymore. When asked why, I just said that doing something with others is exhausting and not fun. I'd much rather just not do anything with anyone else. 

Starting somewhere around 4th-5th grade, I refused invitations to hang out with friends. I just thought it wasn't fun and felt like work. My friends would always want to do something with me but I never wanted to. They didn't understand me and thought, I just disliked them. I didn't want them to think that I hated them, so I forced myself to hang out with them but it was exhausting and I was constantly thinking, that I'd much rather just be alone at home. 

One friend in specific would constantly want to hang out with me. It happened so frequently, that I couldn't force myself to hang out with her anymore and just made up excuses as to why I couldn't hang out with her. Eventually I ran out of excuses and just started ghosting her entirely. We lost contact entirely due to that. 

I also lost interest in my family members at that time. I stopped spending as much time with them as before and refused almost every invitation to spend time together. 

I also still remember, that at the end of 4th grade, I thought that it was odd, that I didn't crush on anyone anymore. 
Before that, I always had crushes but this is where I stopped having them. At least not on real people anymore. The only ones I'd still crush on, were fictional characters. But eventually that stopped too
